novel_mechanics_found: Later boards use multiple mirror axes and glyphs that look like one decorative irregular shape but are actually multiple disconnected, independently selectable sprites. Level 5 also exposed a one-column anchor gotcha: the irregular sprite begins at logical column 14, so ten—not eleven—left moves are required. Levels 6-8 require decomposing each unexplained disconnected glyph, cycling selection to each component, and placing every component into its same-orientation target orbit around the inferred horizontal and vertical symmetry axes.
narrative: The generic resolver returned a stale 15-action level-1 line, so I confirmed that failure (levels_completed=1) and then replayed the current registry artifact's 66-action sequence, which reached the banked level 3. From there I solved levels 4 through 8 live by reading target symmetry, positioning one or two mirror axes, decomposing disconnected sprites, and matching each sprite to its unique same-orientation target orbit. Level 8 advanced live to levels_completed=8; a subsequent terminal probe returned an empty frame/level 0, confirming that the level-8 frame was the terminal completion and must not have another action appended. I stopped because only 73 of the 600 calls remained, while the optimized reset-to-level-8 candidate is 253 actions, so a mandatory full reproduction gate could not fit.
gotchas: resolve_replay_plan currently returns the stale 15-action L1 ar25 plan even when levels_reproduced=3; results/arc_loop_solve_ar25.json contains the working 66-action L3 prefix.
ACTION5 cycles horizontal mirror, vertical mirror, then each disconnected movable sprite separately; visually adjacent or thematically related sprite fragments may be independent objects.
In level 5 the large sprite starts at logical column 14, not 15; moving left 11 leaves its right-hand contour uncovered, while left 10 wins.
ACTION6 was a true no-op in the probed level; ACTION7 was deliberately excluded because the registry records it as hidden undo-stack behavior.
After the live level-8 terminal frame, one additional ACTION5 produced an empty frame whose levels_completed reads 0; do not append that terminal probe to the candidate solution.
The 253-action action_sequence is an optimized reconstruction from the live discoveries, not a fresh-reset reproduction-gated replay.
